title: The Arab-Israeli conflict
brief_description: An impartial analysis of the political and teeritorial problems of the Israelis and the Arabs with the differences being traced back to Abraham. Key areas in the disputes are indicated with maps. No other credits available. Suitable for Upper Secondary students.
